title: My customizable shoot em up with mechs, now has a demo available.
author: crumbaker
selftext:
This is a shoot em up with a fully customizable mech character. You find schematics in the levels that you can build in the armory. Can give it a try here: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5483280/Metal\_Wayfarer/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5483280/Metal_Wayfarer/?beta=0)

Was made in Opus 5.5 max quality. I highly suggest people only use max quality for their games if you're serious about development. On the $200 plan and think it's worth every penny. I just started out with the character prompt, then when onto the levels, bosses etc. As I've said before one shots = bad. Do the opposite and build incrementally.

comments.author: Shalke97
comments.body: Reminds me of BOTZ If anyone remembers. I really Like the Idea. I would Play an online Game Like that again

replies.body: Thanks, it's a single player game though.
